name: io.github.lookproof/lookproof-mcp
title: Lookproof DNS and mail security checks
description: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, DNSSEC, TLS and DNS checks for domains, paid per call in USDC (x402)

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to pay for calls. Without it every tool is a dry run that only reports the price.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file (chmod 600) with the private key of a dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet (alternative to PRIVATE_KEY_FILE)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per session (one server process) in USD

environmentVariables.name: PAYTO_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated addresses the server may pay; a 402 asking for any other payTo is refused
